clinical_sibling_association.description: ProteinGym ClinVar single substitutions on held-out proteins: benign variants should keep the mutated unit inside the same family more often than pathogenic variants.
clinical_sibling_association.note: Paper numbers (results) are PUMA(BLOSUM62, 0.7, 0.05) and BPE at 6,400 units on the full ClinVar pool. The gym scores the hidden test half of the proteins (split by protein); scaled setup: 6,400 units instead of the paper's headline 51,200.

benign_same_sibling_rate.description: Among benign substitutions whose unit boundaries are unchanged (SAME cases), fraction where the original and mutated units at the site belong to the same family. Reported; scored through the gap.

pathogenic_same_sibling_rate.description: Same rate for pathogenic substitutions. Reported; scored through the gap.

benign_pathogenic_gap.description: Benign minus pathogenic SAME sibling rate: how much more often within-family substitutions are benign than pathogenic (bounded in [-1, 1]). Scored as measured when both biological tasks are solved (see task_solved), otherwise as min(measured, 0); a submission failing a validity constraint scores -1.

benign_same_idx.description: Fraction of benign substitutions that leave every unit boundary unchanged (SAME). Reported; gated at >= 0.2.

pathogenic_same_idx.description: Fraction of pathogenic substitutions that leave every unit boundary unchanged (SAME). Reported; gated at >= 0.2.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary units that belong to a multi-member family (validated genealogy). Reported.

vocab_size.description: Number of vocabulary units (budget 6,400, enforced as a validity gate). Reported.

task_solved.description: 1 if both biological tasks are solved: benign-pathogenic gap >= 0.04 AND positive-negative gap >= 0.014 (about half of the published 6,400-unit effects), else 0. When 0, neither gap earns credit (each is scored as min(measured, 0)), so failing one task cannot be compensated by the other. Reported only.

valid.description: 1 if the submission passed every validity constraint (budget <= 6400 units, lossless segmentation of every scored protein, consistent substitution-variant genealogy, >= 2.0 residues per unit, units at most 5% shorter than the frequency-only baseline's (compression_vs_bpe >= 0.95), >= 3200 distinct units used, >= 20% of each label's variants with unchanged unit boundaries), else 0. Reported only: a failed submission already receives the worst value of every scored metric.

dms_sibling_association.description: ProteinGym human DMS single substitutions on held-out protein regions: positive (high-fitness) variants should keep the mutated unit inside the same family more often than negative (low-fitness) variants.
dms_sibling_association.note: Paper numbers are the released 6,400-unit analysis on all human DMS single substitutions; the gym scores the hidden half of 50-residue protein windows.

positive_same_sibling_rate.description: Among positive (high-fitness) substitutions whose unit boundaries are unchanged (SAME cases), fraction where the original and mutated units at the site belong to the same family. Reported; scored through the gap.

negative_same_sibling_rate.description: Same rate for negative (low-fitness) substitutions. Reported; scored through the gap.

positive_negative_gap.description: Positive minus negative SAME sibling rate: how much more often within-family substitutions are positive (high-fitness) than negative (low-fitness) (bounded in [-1, 1]). Scored as measured when both biological tasks are solved (see task_solved), otherwise as min(measured, 0); a submission failing a validity constraint scores -1.

positive_same_idx.description: Fraction of positive (high-fitness) substitutions that leave every unit boundary unchanged (SAME). Reported; gated at >= 0.2.

negative_same_idx.description: Fraction of negative (low-fitness) substitutions that leave every unit boundary unchanged (SAME). Reported; gated at >= 0.2.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary units that belong to a multi-member family (validated genealogy). Reported.

vocab_size.description: Number of vocabulary units (budget 6,400, enforced as a validity gate). Reported.

task_solved.description: 1 if both biological tasks are solved: benign-pathogenic gap >= 0.04 AND positive-negative gap >= 0.014 (about half of the published 6,400-unit effects), else 0. When 0, neither gap earns credit (each is scored as min(measured, 0)), so failing one task cannot be compensated by the other. Reported only.

valid.description: 1 if the submission passed every validity constraint (budget <= 6400 units, lossless segmentation of every scored protein, consistent substitution-variant genealogy, >= 2.0 residues per unit, units at most 5% shorter than the frequency-only baseline's (compression_vs_bpe >= 0.95), >= 3200 distinct units used, >= 20% of each label's variants with unchanged unit boundaries), else 0. Reported only: a failed submission already receives the worst value of every scored metric.

vocabulary_structure.description: Constraint side: the vocabulary must stay a genuine 6,400-unit segmentation. Units used on the scored proteins should be as long as frequency-only BPE units (the paper reports nearly identical observed unit lengths; units more than 5% shorter fail the run), while families are explicit and valid.
vocabulary_structure.note: compression_vs_bpe and residues_per_token paper values come from the authors' released general_stats.csv (observed unit length on the training corpus at 6,400 units: PUMA 2.3999, BPE 2.4599). family_coverage / fractions are the paper's reported vocabulary statistics.

compression_vs_bpe.description: Residues per unit on the scored proteins divided by the same quantity for the evaluator's frequency-only BPE baseline, capped at 1: spending vocabulary on variants should not sacrifice segmentation granularity. Below 0.95 the run fails (scored 0).

residues_per_token.description: Mean residues per unit when segmenting the scored proteins (gated at >= 2.0). Reported.

observed_token_count.description: Distinct units used when segmenting the scored proteins (gated at >= 3200). Reported.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary units in a multi-member family. Reported.

mutated_vocab_fraction.description: Fraction of vocabulary units linked to a parent (mutational variants). Reported.

parent_vocab_fraction.description: Fraction of vocabulary units that are the parent of at least one variant. Reported.

family_count.description: Number of multi-member families. Reported (unnormalized counts are not scored).

mean_family_size.description: Mean size of multi-member families. Reported.

largest_family_fraction.description: Largest family size divided by vocabulary size. Reported.

vocab_size.description: Number of vocabulary units (budget 6,400, gated). Reported.

valid.description: 1 if the submission passed every validity constraint (budget <= 6400 units, lossless segmentation of every scored protein, consistent substitution-variant genealogy, >= 2.0 residues per unit, units at most 5% shorter than the frequency-only baseline's (compression_vs_bpe >= 0.95), >= 3200 distinct units used, >= 20% of each label's variants with unchanged unit boundaries), else 0. Reported only: a failed submission already receives the worst value of every scored metric.
